A.claim: rank_Z J^-(L) < 8 where L is the degree-10 extension of k = Q(sqrt5) generated by a root of x^10 + 256, so that Chabauty-Coleman applies to C^-(L) - the field that actually contains the points coming from solutions of X^10 + 256 Y^10 = Z^17.

B.claim: At p=3: if 3 divides none of A,B,C and 3 divides both x and y, then C^z = 2 or 7 mod 9, and consequently 3 does not divide z. Elementary (the cubes among units mod 9 are exactly {1,8}), independent of FLT3.
